newsitem.title: UK: Reed climbs on confident trade update.
newsitem.headline: Reed climbs on confident trade update.

text.p: Shares in publisher Reed International rose on Thursday after Anglo-Dutch group Reed-Elsevier issued a positive trading update.
The shares advanced 17-1/2p to 11.69 stg by 0952 GMT.
Reed Elsevier said it was confident about the business prospects for the second half of 1996 and would use strong cash flows to fund acquisitions and invest in its technological infrastructure.

The statement also said the recent strengthening of sterling had in the second half reversed the two percent gain that currency translation had added to growth in first half attributable profit, leaving the full year impact netural.
